text:
Ravi: quick heads-up — after tonight's RBAC rename + KMS alias swap we've got a spike of SCIM creates for tenant 'horizon'. Looks like provisioner couldn't decrypt externalId, created new users.

Tess: errors?

Ravi: log sample:
`provisioner: error=KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED principal=scim-provisioner-prod ctx=extid:svc-horizon-42`
`scim: PATCH /scim/v2/Users/old-uid -> 201 Created (new id u-7c2)`. Old user still exists.

ben-oncall: timeline?

Ravi: KMS alias rotate at 03:10 UTC, RBAC role rename started 03:14, fleet deploy 03:18. Spike from 03:19-03:23 (approx 86 creates).

kms-bot: [audit] Key alias alias/redwood-prod-extid changed by infra-ci at 2026-05-12T03:10:12Z.

Tess: most likely policy change removed old principal. Some nodes still running old role so decrypt works; others get AccessDenied -> treat missing extid -> create new user.

ben-oncall: mitigation suggestions?

Ravi: short term: add previous principal back to key policy, pause SCIM autosync for horizon, and run reconcile.

Tess: I re-added `arn:aws:iam::111111:role/scim-provisioner-prod` to the key policy at 03:30 and bumped KMS audit sampling to 100% for that key.

CS-PM: should we notify customer? They saw duplicate service accounts.

Ravi: yes — notify CS with note that duplicates were created but no evidence of credential leak. We'll merge duplicates and rotate affected extids as precaution. Ticket SSO-4021 opened.

ben-oncall: reconcile plan?

Tess: run idempotent merge script (ops/reconcile_extids.sh) in dry-run mode first. Heuristic: match on primary_email + canonical_name, prefer earliest created_id, reassign tokens and delete duplicates after verification. Flag ambiguous for manual.

Ravi: I ran dry-run — found 79 probable merges, 4 ambiguous. Starting maintenance window to merge low-risk ones at 04:15 UTC.

ben-oncall: followups: add pre-rotate checklist item: confirm key policy contains both old and new principals until fleet restarts complete; gate IdP/NameID metadata changes behind KMS readiness check. Also add alert: >10 SCIM creates/min for tenant -> auto-pause autosync and page eng-security.

Tess: creating PR for runbook updates and alerting rules now.

kms-bot: [note] increased KMS audit retention for alias/redwood-prod-extid for 24h.

Ravi: tracking in SSO-4021, will post merge results. oncall staying on it. :white_check_mark:
